population: Saved G3 test predictions for responses whose two photos have the same cat ID and comparison_type within_cat.
selection: Use the existing G3 validation-selected representation and already-frozen models. Do not select or refit models using this subgroup.

uncertainty.unit: held-out photo with at least one within-cat response
uncertainty.interval: 95% pointwise percentile, shared resamples for all models and contrasts
uncertainty.denominator: Recompute total response multiplicity in each cluster resample.
uncertainty.limitations: Exploratory and unadjusted for multiplicity, conditional on fitted models and selection; shared known photos, cats, and respondents may still induce dependence.

operational_support.meaning: Reporting gate, not a power guarantee.

interpretation: In a within-cat comparison the M1 cat-score difference cancels; M1 is a fitted displayed-side intercept and cannot distinguish the two photos. Comparisons are predictive and not causal.
prohibitions: changing the original G2 or G3 frozen artifacts
prior_exposure: G3 was not reserved at Stage 0; its outcomes overlap earlier analyses. This is not an independent confirmatory test.
